name: B10-0130/2024 (The Left) – People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
title: People’s Republic of China’s misinterpretation of the UN resolution 2758 and its continuous military provocations around Taiwan
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for calm in the Taiwan Strait. It says it supports the One China policy, meaning the EU treats the People's Republic of China as the only legitimate representative of China. It criticises China's recent military drills near Taiwan and also criticises the United States for building military alliances and selling weapons to Taiwan. It asks all sides to stop military build-ups and talk instead. This is an opinion. It does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- **Who it affects:** The EU, China, the United States, Taiwan and countries in the region.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to those governments. No action is required.
